sourcePolicy: All questions in this pack are Ready2Go original draft practice items unless an individual record states otherwise. No official JAMB past-question corpus is included. Human subject-matter and answer-key review is required before public release.

questions.question: Which component executes instructions and coordinates many computer operations?
questions.explanation: The central processing unit executes instructions.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: RAM is best described as what?
questions.explanation: RAM normally loses its contents when power is removed.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: ROM traditionally stores which kind of information?
questions.explanation: ROM retains stored information without power.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: An operating system primarily manages what?
questions.explanation: Operating systems manage memory, processes, devices and files.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Phishing is an attempt to do what?

options.D: Trick people into revealing information or installing malicious content

questions.explanation: Phishing uses deceptive messages or sites to steal information.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: An algorithm is what?

options.C: A finite, ordered set of steps for solving a problem

questions.explanation: Algorithms describe steps to solve a problem.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: The binary number system uses which digits?
questions.explanation: Binary is base two and uses 0 and 1.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which is an input device?
questions.explanation: A keyboard sends user input to the computer.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which device is primarily used to display visual output?
questions.explanation: A monitor presents visual output.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: A database is organised data that can be what?
questions.explanation: Databases support structured storage and retrieval.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: A LAN typically covers what?

options.B: A limited local area such as a building or campus
options.C: The entire planet in every case

questions.explanation: A local area network connects nearby devices.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: HTTPS helps protect web traffic by using what?
questions.explanation: HTTPS secures HTTP connections using TLS.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: A file extension often helps identify what?

options.A: The physical weight of the computer
options.D: The file type or associated format

questions.explanation: Extensions commonly indicate file formats.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: In a spreadsheet, a cell is identified by what?
questions.explanation: Cell addresses combine column and row labels.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which is a good password practice?

options.B: Use a unique, long password and a password manager

questions.explanation: Unique long passwords reduce credential-reuse risk.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.
